name: COLFORM
recent: 公司于2025年10月宣布以约2520万令吉现金收购一块工业地，并已发布截至2025年9月30日及2026年9月30日止季度的业绩报告。近期没有重大新闻。
notable: 全资子公司Colform Sdn Bhd与Central Spectrum (M) Sdn Bhd签订买卖协议，以约2520万令吉现金收购一块99年租赁期的工业地。

recent_en: The company announced in October 2025 the proposed acquisition of an industrial land for approximately RM25.2 million cash, and has released quarterly results for the periods ended 30 September 2025 and 30 September 2026. There is no major recent news.
notable_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Colform Sdn Bhd entered into a sale and purchase agreement with Central Spectrum (M) Sdn Bhd to acquire a 99-year leasehold industrial land for approximately RM25.2 million cash.
